Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of this game! Things are heating up in Women's World Cup, 2022 and we have another exciting game coming up on Monday, 21st March. West Indies Women will lock horns with Pakistan Women at Seddon Park in Hamilton. The clash begins at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT) but you can tune in early for the build-up. Till then, cheers and goodbye!

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, says that they are just sticking to the tradition of the tournament, and they are relieved to get over the line here. Mentions that the games they have lost have been close and she feels good to get over the line, but they have to be better, and the top-order needs to step up, but the main thing was to win today. On Charlotte Dean, she says that Dean is a wicket-taker and she has come in and done well. Adds that there is a bit of relief now, but they will reflect on what they could have done better. She concludes by saying that they have not been playing their best cricket yet, but they have two more important games coming up.

Sophie Devine, the skipper of New Zealand Women, says that she always wanted to be out there, but she is very proud of her team, and they were probably 20 runs short, and they are gutted but this is cricket in the end. Mentions that they lost three games by close margins, but it is time to reflect and look back on what they could have done differently, but a lot of positives to take from these games. She adds that they also have one last game and they want to give their best. States that they want to enjoy every moment, rather than the highs and lows in the tournament. Informs that her back will hopefully be fine in a few days.

Natalie Sciver is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says she did not realize how much it was raining while she batted, but the rain did change things a bit. Mentions that it's about partnerships and one of them had to stay there and take them home. Unfortunately, none of them did that. States that usually, she is nervous in the middle, but she had to make sure that she did the bulk of the scoring and be out there. Informs that it was tough to bowl in these conditions but the bowlers did well today.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

New Zealand Women gave it their all with the ball and in the field but ended up on the wrong side of the result. They were hit with injuries but the White Ferns kept fighting till the very end and gave a scare to the defending champions. The injury to Lea Tahuhu weakened their attack a bit but the other bowlers kept things tight and it was Jess Kerr who picked up a couple of important wickets, which included the prized scalp of a set batter in Natalie Sciver. However, it was Frances Mackay who turned the game on its head at the fag end as she took wickets in a cluster and brought New Zealand back in the contest. Had they scored 15-20 more runs, things might have been different at the end of the day. Having said that, England Women deserved to win this game in spite of that collapse, as they dominated the game for a majority part.

England Women didn't have a huge total to chase but they did get off to a decent start. Although they lost Wyatt early on in the innings, it was the pair of Tammy Beaumont and Heather Knight who kept them in the hunt. Beaumont perished but Knight carried on in her merry way and she stitched another crucial partnership along with Natalie Sciver. However, England Women lost a couple of wickets in quick succession in the middle overs and they were in a spot of bother. Then came the partnership between Sophia Dunkley and Natalie Sciver which almost guaranteed them a win. However, there was a huge collapse once Dunkley got out where England lost 5 wickets for just 20 runs. Heather Knight and her troops would be relieved in the end as it was a must-win encounter for them.

Hannah Rowe (4-1-21-0) comes back into the attack.
Full and outside off. Knight drives it past the diving fielder at cover and retains the strike by taking a single.
Another ball that is short and around off. Knight taps it to the off side.
Shorter in length, outside off. Sciver drops it wide of the point fielder and sets off for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Natalie Sciver taps it towards backward point.
Fuller in length, on middle. Natalie Sciver drives it to mid on.
A length ball, on middle. Natalie Sciver tucks it to square leg.
This is darted on the pads. Natalie Sciver nudges it around the corner and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Heather Knight steers it to third man for one run.
Shorter in length, outside off. Heather Knight punches it to mid off.
This is a length ball that jags back in from middle. Natalie Sciver flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, blocked out.
Good-length delivery, around off. Natalie Sciver defends it to the off side.
Back of a length, around off. Heather Knight defends it to the off side. A maiden over from Tahuhu!
On a length, around off. Heather Knight keeps it out.
In the air... but it lands safely! Good-length ball, outside off. Knight prods to block but it hits the splice of her bat and falls just short of the cover fielder.
On a length, jagging back in from middle. Knight tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, angling in from off. Heather Knight looks to nudge it around the corner but she misses and gets hit high on her pad.
Good-length ball, around off. Heather Knight keeps it out.
Full-length ball, on middle. Heather Knight clips it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
A full ball, on middle. Natalie Sciver glances it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, just outside off and shaping away a tad. Natalie Sciver prods to block but the ball beats her outside edge.
A full ball, outside off. Natalie Sciver drives it to the cover fielder.
A low full toss, outside off. Natalie Sciver pushes it to mid off.
Wide! A wayward ball, outside off. Natalie Sciver looks to cut but she misses. Wided!
Back of a length, angling down leg. Heather Knight tickles it to fine leg for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! New Zealand Women can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over! Natalie Sciver walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! What a peach of a delivery! A perfect ball to dismiss Tammy Beaumont, who was looking in good touch. Lea Tahuhu strikes and grabs the second wicket for New Zealand Women. Lea Tahuhu becomes New Zealand Women's leading ODI wicket-taker! Tahuhu serves this on a length, around off, nipping back in. Tammy Beaumont was looking to push this one, but she misses as the ball comes back in and sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and goes on to knock the stump over.
On the stumps this time, on a length. Tammy Beaumont blocks it out.
Outside off, on a length. Tammy Beaumont defends it out.
FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat, but the ball will race away! Shorter ball now, on middle. Tammy Beaumont pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up for England Women!
A stifled appeal for LBW, but turned down! On a length, angling in, on the pads. Tammy Beaumont looks to flick this but he misses and gets rapped on her pads. That was probably sliding down leg.
Pitches this one up, around middle. Heather Knight shuffles across and flicks it towards mid-wicket. Single taken!
Swinging in, around off, on a good length. Tammy Beaumont blocks it out.
On a length, around middle. Tammy Beaumont lunges and defends it out.
FOUR! Wow, wonderful shot! Full once again, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leans forward and carves it past cover for a glorious boundary.
Full again, on middle. Heather Knight whips it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Wide! Heather Knight serves this down the leg side, on a fuller length. Heather Knight misses her flick and wide given!
Pitched up delivery, around off. Heather Knight drives it on the right of the fielder at mid off.
Very full, on middle. Tammy Beaumont works it away past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Change of ends for Hannah Rowe.
Another pitched up delivery, on the pads. Tammy Beaumont flicks it past mid-wicket. Three taken! 10 runs off Lea Tahuhu's first over!
On a length this time, outside off again. Heather Knight guides it towards third man for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Heather Knight stays in her crease and chops it towards third man for a brace.
Another fuller ball, around off. Heather Knight once again drives and finds the fielder at mid off this time.
FOUR! Glorious shot! An overpitched delivery, around middle. Heather Knight shows the full face of her bat and drives it past mid on for a boundary.
Lea Tahuhu begins with a length delivery, wide of off. Heather Knight cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Lea Tahuhu comes into the attack.
Another pitched up delivery, around off. Tammy Beaumont has pushed it towards mid off.
Very full, swinging in, around middle. Tammy Beaumont pushes it back to the bowler.
Tad fuller, outside off. Tammy Beaumont lunges forward and blocks it out watchfully.
On a length, around middle. Tammy Beaumont defends it out.
Fuller ball, darting it on the pads. Heather Knight flicks it past square leg for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! A low full, outside off. Heather Knight leans and creams it past cover for a beautiful boundary.
Yorker-length delivery, around off. Tammy Beaumont digs it out towards cover. Good over for England Women, 9 runs off it.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Tammy Beaumont presses forward and leaves it alone.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Hannah Rowe misses her length and serves a low full toss, around middle. Tammy Beaumont whips it past mid-wicket for another boundary.
Full again, around middle. Tammy Beaumont leans and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Much fuller now, around middle and leg. Tammy Beaumont uses her wrists and flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
On a length, shaping away, outside off. Heather Knight dabs it towards third man for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Tammy Beaumont cuts it to the backward point fielder. Back-to-back maiden overs from New Zealand Women!
Pitched up, outside off. Tammy Beaumont drills it to the cover fielder.
Full and outside off. Tammy Beaumont pushes it to cover.
Back of a length, around off. Tammy Beaumont blocks it to the off side.
This time Tammy drives a full ball straight to the cover fielder.
Pitches it up, outside off. Tammy drives it towards mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Heather Knight cuts it to point. A maiden over from Rowe!
BEATEN! A peach of a delivery from Rowe! This on lands on the fifth stump channel and shapes away late. Knight looks to drive but the ball beats her outside edge.
Short of a length, outside off. Heather Knight lets it through to the keeper.
Good-length delivery, around off. Heather Knight gets forward and defends it.
Fuller in length, on middle. Heather Knight flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
A length ball, on middle. Heather Knight turns it to mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Tammy digs it out on the off side.
Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wyatt looks to go big but holes out! Another ball, full and outside off. Wyatt gets under it and looks to loft it over the mid off fielder. It goes off the toe end towards Hannah Rowe at mid off who backtracks and takes a really good catch. A huge wicket for New Zealand Women as the dangerous Wyatt walks back.
Commentary.Howout: c Hannah Rowe b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Firmly struck by Wyatt and she means business! Full and outside off. Wyatt frees her arms and carves it over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Short and wide. Tammy Beaumont mistimes her cut shot towards third man for a single.
This is a length ball, around off. Tammy prods to defend but it hits the splice of her bat and falls in front of the bowler.
Good-length delivery, well outside off. Tammy Beaumont offers no shot to that one.
Rowe bowls it short this time, outside off. Wyatt cuts it to the backward point fielder.
FOUR! Top shot! This is an overpitched ball, just outside off. Wyatt prods and lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Wyatt taps it to cover-point.
Back of a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt skips down the track and looks to cut but she misses.
Full and around leg. Tammy Beaumont flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fuller in length, outside off. Tammy Beaumont drives it to the cover fielder.
Hannah Rowe will bowl from the other end.
FOUR! A gift from Jess and Wyatt accepts it gleefully. A full toss, around off. Wyatt carves it through the cover region for a boundary. 7 runs off the first over!
On a length, around off. Tammy Beaumont taps it to cover-point and takes off for a quick run.
A short ball, around off. Tammy Beaumont pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg and takes a couple of runs. England Women are up and running!
Good-length delivery, around off. Tammy Beaumont gets forward and dabs it onto the deck.
This on lands on a length, around off. Tammy defends it off the front foot.
Jess starts with a full ball, nipping back in from outside off. Tammy Beaumont leaves it alone.
